title: Making contacts
blurb: The big idea before the cards.

lines.caption: Simplex means two radios on one frequency, talking directly and taking turns.
lines.label: simplex

lines.caption: A repeater listens on one frequency and retransmits on another. The gap between them is the offset.
lines.label: repeater

lines.caption: A band plan is a voluntary guide to where each activity goes in a band.
lines.label: band plan

lines.caption: On 2 meters, FM simplex calls start on the calling frequency, 146.520 megahertz.
lines.say: On 2 meters, F M simplex calls start on the calling frequency, one forty-six point five two zero megahertz.
lines.label: 146.520 MHz

lines.caption: CQ means calling any station.
lines.say: C Q means calling any station.
lines.label: CQ

lines.caption: To answer a call, say the other station's call sign first, then your own.
lines.label: theirs, then yours
